title: Start an authorized release and publish the qualified packages
actor: A maintainer authorized to initiate a supported release
goal: Start publication of reviewed release input once and receive the checked public outcome without another approval.
context: Reviewed release intent and supported publication setup are established; actual packages will be prepared and checked by the release operation.
trigger: The maintainer initiates the authorized release workflow for the selected reviewed source.
preconditions: Reviewed source, version intent, publication destinations and permitted workflow are identified.
The maintainer has authority to initiate this release; required setup is established.

interaction.action: Initiates the supported release operation for the selected reviewed source and configured destinations.
Prepares, checks and retains the exact packages, showing their identities and check results.
Publishes the retained qualified packages without asking for another approval and reports actual public verification and closeout.

expected_outcome: The authorized start leads to qualified publication and an honest result without an intervening human approval.

alternatives.condition: The same operation is retried after interruption.
alternatives.outcome: The original retained packages and observed public state determine the remaining authorized work; no redundant approval or duplicate publication.

failures.condition: Candidate bytes, source, configuration, destinations, or required evidence change materially or become invalid.
failures.outcome: Publication stops until affected requalification and applicable authorization address the new subject.

failures.condition: A conflicting public tag/artifact, missing authentication prerequisite, or unavailable authorization is found.
failures.outcome: The operation stops without overwrite or unapproved fallback.
Known effects are recorded and public state must be inspected before any retry.

failures.condition: A requested special release lies outside routine automation.
failures.outcome: Its need for an explicit supported owner disposition is reported rather than relabeling it routine.

failures.condition: A required check fails, or execution comes from local checks, PR validation or an unauthorized trigger.
failures.outcome: Publication is blocked; workflow execution or a passing unrelated check cannot manufacture authority.
